verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk or batch operation capability for Workers, such as bulk edits or batch writes across many items. The Code Mode MCP execute() tool, Queues, and Workflows are building blocks a developer could use to construct bulk operations, not the capability itself. The only passing reference is an example event type ('a Workers AI batch request being queued'), which does not document bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
